name: product-safety-info
title: Product safety information
description: The product safety facts regulations ask for: manufacturer and EU contact, model and batch, warnings, compliance marks and documents.
docs: Pass what you have: a section without content is left out, never shown empty. warnings are { severity ('danger' | 'warning' | 'caution' | 'notice'), title?, text }, most serious first. Every severity is written as a word ('Danger', 'Warning', 'Caution', 'Note') in front of the text, with an icon and a fill that grow stronger as the risk does, so nothing relies on colour or an icon alone. marks are { name ('CE'), description?, href? } and link to the declaration behind them. manufacturer and euContact are { name, address (an array of lines, or one string with line breaks), email?, phone?, website?, role? }, written in an address element with mail, call and web links. identifiers are { label, value, where? } for the model, the batch and the serial number and where each is printed. documents are { title, href, type?, size? (bytes), language? }, each with a download button that is only the icon in a narrow panel. updatedAt, locale and timeZone write 'Checked 12 October 2026' and the file sizes. linkAs renders the links with your router's Link, and action puts something at the right of the heading, such as the close button of a dialog, so nothing lies over the panel's own text, and stickyHeader pins that heading, and the button with it, to the top of whatever scrolls the panel, so the close button of a dialog never scrolls out of reach on a phone. The panel has no width of its own, so it sits as well in a tab or a dialog as on the page, and it keeps no state, so it renders on the server.
